title: 考研英语（一）阅读新题型真题实战库

tasks.theme: 社会学与数字时代的劳动力变迁
tasks.title: 远程协作模式对企业组织架构的重塑

paragraphs.text: Such digital pioneers established decentralized communication protocols, allowing team members across different time zones to collaborate seamlessly without constant physical supervision.
paragraphs.clue: 【代词指代链】开头含 'Such digital pioneers'，必紧接在首次提及先驱企业或科研机构的段落之后。

paragraphs.text: In recent decades, the profound transition towards remote working has revolutionized organizational paradigms across the global technology and knowledge sectors.
paragraphs.clue: 【标准首段特征】交代宏观时代背景 'In recent decades, ... has revolutionized...'，引出全文核心议题。

paragraphs.text: However, this flexible model also poses severe psychological challenges, including chronic employee isolation and blurred boundaries between professional duties and private life.
paragraphs.clue: 【逻辑转折】转折词 'However' 承接上文关于远程协作的效率优势，转入对心理孤独与工作边界模糊的探讨。

paragraphs.text: To mitigate these adverse effects, forward-thinking executives are introducing asynchronous wellness check-ins and hybrid physical gathering spaces.
paragraphs.clue: 【对策解决句】句首 'To mitigate these adverse effects' 紧扣段落 C 提出的多重负面挑战，给出终极解决方案。

tasks.analysis: ① 首段选 B：宏观交代远程办公历史变革；② 第二段选 A：以 'Such digital pioneers' 承接 B 中的变革先锋；③ 第三段选 C：以 'However, this flexible model' 引入挑战；④ 第四段选 D：以 'To mitigate these adverse effects' 给出应对策略。
